status: exploratory descriptives for the draft red-team; no registered value changes

cache_reuse.definition: post-branch (periods 101-150) incumbent LLM decisions (slots 0-3) of the qualified trunks; from_sham = cache_hit true and the same-trunk sham logged a live call (cache_hit false) at the same period and slot with the same prompt hash and the same raw output; share = n_from_sham / n_decisions (pooled); all_trunks pools every trunk the arm ran on

positive_control.definition: the same rule with S2 as the reference: S1c-LLM-TR-H decisions served from the same-trunk S2 run's answers (a known replay)

l6c_minus_l6.definition: Delta C(L6c) - Delta C(L6) = capped idx(L6) - capped idx(L6c) per trunk (registered per-run delta_p, trunk benchmarks, window 111-150), BCa 95 %
